name: Friendly Rivalry [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You stoke your allies to fight harder when glory is on the line, egging them on to victory in single combat before your own.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): If you’re the only one threatening a foe and an ally within 30 feet is the only creature threatening a different foe, your ally gains a +2 morale bonus on melee attack rolls against the foe that only they are threatening. Your allies gain this bonus only if neither of the qualifying opponents is flat-footed, helpless or otherwise unable to act. Your allies must be able to see you in order to gain the benefits of this feat. If another ally who is not threatening the chosen foes makes any sort of attack against said foes (such as a ranged attack or a spell), your allies lose this feat’s benefit for 1 round. Multiple allies can benefit from this feat at once, so long as they meet all other prerequisites.
